question: Pandit Birju Maharaj was honoured with Padma Vibhushan award for which form of classical dance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kathak.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pandit Birju Maharaj** was honoured with **Padma Vibhushan** award for **Kathak.**
 
• Kathak is a form of** classical dance **that originated in **North India.**
 
• Kathak is known for its** intricate footwork, fast spins**, and **storytelling **through **mime and gesture.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Manipuri **is a classical dance form from Manipur.

 
 
• It is known for its **graceful movements, lyrical quality**, and use of **traditional costumes and props**.
 
 
 
• **Jhumar **is a** folk dance** form from **Punjab.**
 
 
• It is traditionally performed by** men** and involves **vigorous movements and acrobatics.**
 
 
 
• **Mohiniattam **is a classical dance form from **Kerala**.
 
• It is known for its** fluid movements, delicate hand gestures,** and **facial expressions.**
 
• Hence, the **correct answer** is option 2.
